data_move.mc:
microcode_format 2

# One shared entry; the decoder supplies the word-register destination.
instruction MOV_R16_IMM16:
    FETCH_IMM16 -> TMP0
writeback:
    TMP0 -> DST
    END

instruction MOV_RM16_R16:
    DECODE_MODRM
    READ_REG16 -> TMP0
writeback:
    TMP0 -> RM16
    END

instruction MOV_R16_RM16:
    DECODE_MODRM
    READ_RM16 -> TMP0
writeback:
    TMP0 -> REG16
    END
word_alu.mc:
microcode_format 3

# Decode supplies the functional operation, FLAGS mask and IF_WRITE permission.
# TMP0 is always the original destination; TMP1 is always the source.
instruction ALU_RM16_R16:
    DECODE_MODRM
    READ_RM16 -> TMP0
    READ_REG16 -> TMP1
    ALU DECODED TMP0, TMP1 -> TMP2 FLAGS_DECODED
writeback:
    TMP2 -> RM16 IF_WRITE
    COMMIT_FLAGS
    END

instruction ALU_R16_RM16:
    DECODE_MODRM
    READ_REG16 -> TMP0
    READ_RM16 -> TMP1
    ALU DECODED TMP0, TMP1 -> TMP2 FLAGS_DECODED
writeback:
    TMP2 -> REG16 IF_WRITE
    COMMIT_FLAGS
    END

instruction ALU_AX_IMM16:
    READ_DST16 -> TMP0
    FETCH_IMM16 -> TMP1
    ALU DECODED TMP0, TMP1 -> TMP2 FLAGS_DECODED
writeback:
    TMP2 -> DST IF_WRITE
    COMMIT_FLAGS
    END

instruction ALU_RM16_IMM16:
    DECODE_MODRM
    READ_RM16 -> TMP0
    FETCH_IMM16 -> TMP1
    ALU DECODED TMP0, TMP1 -> TMP2 FLAGS_DECODED
writeback:
    TMP2 -> RM16 IF_WRITE
    COMMIT_FLAGS
    END

instruction ALU_RM16_IMM8S:
    DECODE_MODRM
    READ_RM16 -> TMP0
    FETCH_IMM8S -> TMP1
    ALU DECODED TMP0, TMP1 -> TMP2 FLAGS_DECODED
writeback:
    TMP2 -> RM16 IF_WRITE
    COMMIT_FLAGS
    END
word_stack_control.mc:
# Functional stack/near-control operations; no historical timing delays.
microcode_format 4

instruction PUSH_R16:
    READ_DST16 -> TMP0
    PUSH16 DECODED TMP0
    END

instruction POP_R16:
    POP16 -> TMP0
    TMP0 -> DST
    END

instruction PUSH_IMM16:
    FETCH_IMM16 -> TMP0
    PUSH16 DECODED TMP0
    END

instruction PUSH_IMM8S:
    FETCH_IMM8S -> TMP0
    PUSH16 DECODED TMP0
    END

instruction POP_RM16:
    DECODE_MODRM
    CHECK_RM16
    POP16 -> TMP0
    TMP0 -> RM16
    END

instruction GROUP5_NEAR:
    DECODE_MODRM
    READ_RM16 -> TMP0
    TARGET_ABS16 TMP0
    PUSH16 DECODED TMP0
    REDIRECT DECODED
    END

instruction CALL_REL16:
    FETCH_IMM16 -> TMP1
    TARGET_REL16 TMP1
    READ_IP16 -> TMP0
    PUSH16 DECODED TMP0
    REDIRECT DECODED
    END

instruction JMP_REL16:
    FETCH_IMM16 -> TMP1
    TARGET_REL16 TMP1
    REDIRECT DECODED
    END

instruction BRANCH_REL8:
    FETCH_IMM8S -> TMP1
    TARGET_REL16 TMP1
    REDIRECT DECODED
    END

instruction LOOP_REL8:
    FETCH_IMM8S -> TMP1
    COUNT DECODED
    TARGET_REL16 TMP1
    REDIRECT DECODED
    END

instruction RET_NEAR:
    POP16 -> TMP0
    TARGET_ABS16 TMP0
    REDIRECT DECODED
    END

instruction RET_IMM16:
    FETCH_IMM16 -> TMP1
    POP16 -> TMP0
    TARGET_ABS16 TMP0
    ADJUST_SP16 TMP1
    REDIRECT DECODED
    END
